tools.name: limoexpress_list_vehicles
tools.description: List the fleet vehicles of the organisation. GET /api/integration/vehicles.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_vehicle_classes
tools.description: List vehicle classes (for example sedan, van). Class ids are used for pricing. GET /api/integration/vehicle-classes.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_subcontractors
tools.description: List subcontractors (partner operators) of the organisation. GET /api/integration/subcontractors.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_events
tools.description: List events defined in the organisation. GET /api/integration/events.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_clients
tools.description: List clients (customers and organisations) with contact details. GET /api/integration/clients.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_invoices
tools.description: List invoices with their paid status. GET /api/integration/invoices.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_booking_offers
tools.description: List booking offers (quotes sent to clients). GET /api/integration/booking-offers.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_passengers
tools.description: List passengers. The records contain personal data. GET /api/integration/passengers.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_users
tools.description: List users (staff and drivers) of the organisation. GET /api/integration/users.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_expenses
tools.description: List expenses recorded in the organisation. GET /api/integration/expenses.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_payment_methods
tools.description: List payment methods. Ids are used to filter bookings. GET /api/integration/payment-methods.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_all_currencies
tools.description: List every currency the platform supports. GET /api/integration/all-currencies.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_countries
tools.description: List countries known to the platform. GET /api/integration/countries.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_bookings
tools.description: List bookings of the organisation. Filter by pickup time range (yyyy-mm-dd hh:mm:ss), status, type, payment method, vehicle or client id. GET /api/integration/bookings.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_booking_types
tools.description: List booking types. GET /api/integration/booking-types.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_booking_statuses
tools.description: List booking statuses (ids for the status filter). GET /api/integration/booking-statuses.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_organisation_currencies
tools.description: List the currencies enabled for the organisation. GET /api/integration/currencies.

tools.name: limoexpress_get_pricing
tools.description: Get the price for a trip from coordinates, optionally for one vehicle class and currency. Give the destination coordinates, or a distance when there is no destination. GET /api/integration/pricing.

tools.name: limoexpress_list_discount_vouchers
tools.description: List discount vouchers, optionally for one currency. GET /api/integration/discount-vouchers.

tools.name: limoexpress_get_extra_fees_pricing
tools.description: Get the extra fees for one vehicle class and currency. GET /api/integration/extra-fees-pricing/{currencyId}/{vehicleClassId}.

tools.name: limoexpress_mark_booking_as_confirmed
tools.description: WRITE: set one booking to the confirmed status. Use limoexpress_list_bookings to find the id. POST /api/integration/mark-booking-as-confirmed.

tools.name: limoexpress_mark_invoice_as_paid
tools.description: WRITE: record one invoice as paid. This changes the accounting state. Use limoexpress_list_invoices to find the id. POST /api/integration/invoices/mark-as-paid.
